message: Obstacle detection range, required reaction latency, robot-controller interface behavior, and environmental safety constraints are not confirmed; functional architecture must remain non-component-specific until these unknowns are resolved.
suggestedResolution: Confirm the robot’s sensor-to-reaction needs (range and latency), the interface to the robot controller, and the indoor environmental constraints affecting safe reactions.

message: False positive/false negative tolerances and edge-case scenarios for obstacle detection are considered but not sufficiently specified for the initial prototype scope.
suggestedResolution: Clarify acceptable false-positive and false-negative rates (or qualitative tolerances) and identify indoor test scenarios covering edge cases.
